Yes, these should be personal, app-wide preferences that persist, with changes taking effect immediately. “Show more” is preferable to numbered pages for this kind of list.

One important condition: the item limit should affect only how many results are displayed initially. Search and result counts must still cover the entire collection, and “select all” for a filtered view should include every matching bookmark—even those not yet revealed with Show more. The interface should state that clearly.

With that condition, the display preferences are right.
